attchmntText: Pashupati Cotspin Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Pashupati Cotspin Limited intimates that its Memorandum of Association has been amended following requisite member approvals. The authorized share capital is now Rs. 40,00,00,000 divided into 400000000 Equity Shares of Re. 1 each. This notice is issued under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company references its earlier intimation regarding the Scrutinizer’s Report and Declaration of Results of remote e-voting dated November 7, 2026. The amendment was signed by Managing Director Saurin Jagadishbhai Parikh, DIN 02136530.

attchmntText: Pashupati Cotspin Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
voiceSummary: Pashupati Cotspin Limited announces that shareholders have approved two ordinary resolutions via postal ballot. The resolutions include an increase in authorized share capital and the issuance of bonus shares. The voting results were declared on November 7, 2026. The resolutions are deemed passed as of November 6, 2026. Scrutinizer Nisarg Sharma confirmed the results. The company received votes in favor from promoters and public shareholders. No votes were cast against the resolutions. The total valid votes cast were 10,49,49,879. The scrutinizer's report is available on the company website and NSDL portal.

attchmntText: Pashupati Cotspin Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Bonus  is 13-Nov-2026.
Pashupati Cotspin Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 23-Nov-2026.
Pashupati Cotspin Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026 and declaration of Interim Dividend'.
Pashupati Cotspin Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 06, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 0.02 per equity share.
Pashupati Cotspin Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Pashupati Cotspin Limited has informed the Exchange regarding '2. To consider and declare an Interim Dividend, if any, on the equity shares of the Company for the Financial Year 2026-27'.
